Thoughts Pt. 8 11/25/2026

Published on November 24, 2026 by CP

Recently, I’ve been on Instagram a lot. It used to not be a problem, but I can’t really say that anymore. I’m gonna try to reduce my usage in the coming months; I could spend my time on better things, like this website. Anyway, this will be yet another entry of life updates and my thoughts from my phone over the past 10-ish days.

Updates

  • Memphis is finally ranked
  • I finally made and posted the camcorder vid on the yt
  • Thanksgiving is tommorow
  • It’s getting colder
  • GTA VI came out after 13 years
  • In-n-out opened
  • I watched the new Hunger Games

Thoughts

Is it a shake without whip cream or cherry? If a cherry is offered with the shake, why don’t you want the cherry? I can understand not wanting whip cream.

How did people use to watch sports with no score bug? Imagine switching on any game and just not knowing the score or the tension of the game until the announcer said the score. That said, I’ve listened to radio coverage of some football games, and it’s not that bad.

Why are hotel bed sheets always white? If I go to a hotel and have non-white bed sheets, can I conclude I’m at a bad hotel?

#wifedat nah #derivativedat

A’s crinkly ass fit at MUN.

At my elementary school, we had a really good playground. Every year, they would let us use the monkey bars. Every year, within the first month of school, someone would fall and break a few bones, so the monkey bars would get banned for the rest of the year. If I remember correctly, I think the school would ban them for every grade. Fortunately, I was never one of those few who fell and broke a bone, but it was always irritating. I could’ve been a gymnastics pro if they let me use the monkey bars.

What is the police equivalent of a firefighter pole?

Are all drive-thrus counter-clockwise? I understand that the driver is on the left side, but I’d like to see a clockwise drive-thru, just for some variety.

After nearly 8-9 months, my plastic wrap finally ran out. It got me through many recipes and bagels. It will be missed.

What if we called lemonade lemon juice?

Christmas decorating starts on Thanksgiving or the day after, not after Halloween. If you start decorating before Thanksgiving, you’re devaluing Thanksgiving. My only exception is if you go all out and need more time to get your lights and decorations out, then it's okay to decorate before thanksgiving.

Along with that, I don’t like (hate) when people throw their Christmas lights all willy-nilly in their front yards. If you can’t take the time to truly decorate your yard, then you shouldn’t put those lights up. By slinging your lights up wherever you please on your front lawn tree, you’re telling me that your Christmas decorations don’t deserve my attention.

Loot Lake was always my favorite place to land.

Why do we refer to them as John Wilkes Booth and Lee Harvey Oswald?

Why do we call it looking something up? When I need to know something, I don’t physically look up, so why is it called that? (Good thought, R)

John Surratt lived one crazy life.

“Like caprisuns” - D

“Your pants are gripping your yams every day” - to D

Is pooping the bed a thing?

This is the first year I won’t have to rake leaves in a long time.

Can we credit American soccer's rise in popularity to Speed?

The school is located on somewhat of a main road in our town. Whenever we go on school break for something, I always find it funny to see how quickly people start parking their cars for sale in the school lot. It’s as if they’re waiting for the school to go on break so they can start selling their cars. The for-sale signs probably go out of stock at our Walmart whenever we go on break.

Are we more miserable people? I feel like we can’t find joy in the simple things anymore.

I hate taking showers on days I don’t do anything. It makes the shower less meaningful. I still shower, though.

Who would win in a hype battle, SouthMemphisHypeman or Steve DaStoner?

In elementary school, they always showed Free Birds the day before Thanksgiving break at lunch in the cafeteria. I wonder if they still do that? Free Birds is the greatest Thanksgiving movie ever made, btw.

“We're going back in time to the first Thanksgiving to get turkeys off the menu.” -Jake and LW
